description: Schema types and parser for the Lynx `debug-metadata.json` format.

exports.name: Artifact
exports.summary:
One artifact produced by the build that carries at least one debug
data source.

Identity is `(filename, tasmSection)`:
  - `filename` is the asset basename (e.g. `main-thread.js`,
    `background.fd311de1.js`, `main.css`).
  - `tasmSection` is the artifact's location inside `tasm.json` and
    disambiguates artifacts that share a filename pattern but live in
    different sections.

`tasmSection` is a path array of nested-object segments because raw
keys (especially under `customSections`) may themselves contain dots
and cannot be safely collapsed into a dotted string. Examples:

  - `['lepusCode', 'root']`        main-thread.js
  - `['lepusCode', 'chunks', '0']` async main-thread chunk
  - `['manifest', '/<asset-name>']` background JS bundle
  - `['customSections', 'data.v2']` custom section whose key has a dot
  - `['css']`                      a CSS artifact

members.name: debugSources
members.summary:
Debug sources for this artifact, ordered to match the
reverse-symbolication decode chain. A consumer that starts with a
runtime location and wants to recover the original source iterates
this list left-to-right:

1. `bytecode-debug-info` (if present) maps the bytecode PC offset
   back to the encoded JS source's `(line, column)`.
2. `source-map` then maps that `(line, column)` back to the
   original authored file.

members.name: filename
members.summary:
The name this artifact is addressed by: the emitted file's basename, or
the section name when the bundle carries it as a custom section.

members.name: kind
members.summary:
Which encoder bucket this asset belongs to in `tasm.json`:

- `main-thread` — JS that runs on the lepusNG main thread (compiled
  into the `lepusCode` section).
- `background` — JS that runs on the background JS engine (lives in
  the `manifest` section).
- `css` — extracted CSS chunk (lives in the `css` section).

members.name: path
members.summary:
Bundler-relative path of the emitted asset itself (e.g.
`.lynx/main/main-thread.js`). Distinct from
[`SourceMapDebugSource.path`](api:SourceMapDebugSource.path), which points at the
sibling `.map` file.

exports.name: BytecodeDebugInfoSource
exports.summary:
Bytecode debug info for a main-thread artifact compiled to lepusNG
(and, in the future, other bytecode targets).

members.name: debugInfo
members.summary:
Bytecode debug payload. Today always lepusNG-shaped; if/when other
encoders (`quickjs`, …) need to coexist, a `target` discriminator
will be added.

exports.name: DebugMetadataAsset
exports.summary:
Full `debug-metadata.json` payload emitted per Lynx template entry.

Asymmetry note: `artifacts[]` is **per-artifact** (one entry per JS /
CSS / bytecode bundle) while `uiSourceMap` is **per-entry** (there is
exactly one UI sourcemap for the entry's runtime UI tree). Forcing
`uiSourceMap` into `artifacts[]` would require inventing a synthetic
artifact, conflating runtime concepts with build products.

Different consumers read different fields:
  - JS error reverse-symbolication walks `artifacts[]` for
    `kind: 'source-map'` debug sources.
  - Main-thread bytecode reverse-symbolication walks `artifacts[]`
    for `kind: 'bytecode-debug-info'` + the matching `source-map`.
  - UI element inspectors read `uiSourceMap` directly.

members.name: artifacts
members.summary:
One entry per build artifact that ships debug data. Empty when the
emitter has not yet been wired to populate it; consumers should
treat an empty array as "no source-level debug data available"
rather than an error.

members.name: buildInfo
members.summary:
Build-time / context info. Closed-shape today — extend by adding
named fields to this interface (and bumping the schema) rather than
by stuffing arbitrary keys at runtime.

members.name: uiSourceMap
members.summary: Compact UI source map for the entry's runtime UI tree.

exports.name: FieldResolver
exports.summary:
Describes how to look up one queryable field and (optionally) which
sub-field of the matched value to return to callers.

`resolve` runs the lookup. `payload` is an optional unwrapper: for a
`source-map` query, the resolver returns the full
[`SourceMapDebugSource`](api:SourceMapDebugSource) wrapper but HTTP consumers typically want
the raw Source Map v3 JSON — `payload: sm => sm.map` performs the
unwrap.

members.name: resolve
members.type: resolve(metadata: DebugMetadataAsset, params: QueryParams): T | undefined

exports.name: GitMetadata
exports.summary: Git metadata captured at build time.

members.name: rootDir
members.summary:
Absolute path of the git worktree root
(`git rev-parse --show-toplevel`). Consumers use this to resolve
source-relative paths inside source maps back to filesystem
locations during reverse symbolication.

exports.name: LepusNGDebugInfo
exports.summary:
lepusNG-encoded bytecode's debug payload, identical to the JSON the
encoder writes to `debug-info.json`. The top-level `lepusNG_debug_info`
key is preserved so consumers (Lynx runtime, reverse-symbolication
services) can treat a `?field=bytecode-debug-info` response and the
legacy `debug-info.json` file as the same shape.

exports.name: LepusNGDebugInfoBody
exports.summary:
Inner body of [`LepusNGDebugInfo`](api:LepusNGDebugInfo). Carries the function-level
debug data the lepusNG encoder produces for one compilation unit.

members.name: end_line_num
members.summary: Last source line covered by the compilation unit.

members.name: function_info
members.summary: Per-function debug data.

members.name: function_number
members.summary: Number of compiled functions; equals `function_info.length`.

members.name: function_source
members.summary: Full JS source that was fed to the bytecode compiler.

exports.name: LepusNGFunctionInfo
exports.summary:
Debug data for one lepusNG function: maps bytecode PC offsets back to
`(line, column)` in the original source, plus optional caller info.

members.name: column_number
members.summary: Source column where the function definition starts (0-based).

members.name: line_col
members.summary:
Decoded line/column pairs, one per source position emitted by the
compiler. `line_col.length` matches the number of mappings encoded
in `pc2line_buf`.

members.name: line_number
members.summary: Source line where the function definition starts (1-based).

members.name: pc2caller_info
members.summary:
Optional PC offset → caller source snippet. Keys are stringified
PC offsets; values are the original function bodies the bytecode
was inlined from. Useful for de-inlining stack traces.

members.name: pc2line_buf
members.summary:
Variable-length encoding of the PC-to-line table. Decode rules
are documented in the lepusNG bytecode debug-info spec.

members.name: pc2line_len
members.summary: Length of `pc2line_buf` in bytes.

exports.name: QueryParams
exports.summary: Parameters every resolver receives. Resolvers pick the keys they need.

members.name: filename
members.summary: Asset basename (e.g. `main-thread.js`).

members.name: key
members.summary: Chunk hash / release identifier.

members.name: path
members.summary: Bundler-relative asset path (e.g. `.lynx/main/main-thread.js.map`).

exports.name: RemappedUiNode
exports.summary:
A [`UiNode`](api:UiNode) after reverse-resolution. Nodes whose `nodeIndex` is
known to their `debugMetadataUrl`'s UI source map gain the
[`UiSourceLocation`](api:UiSourceLocation) fields; all others are returned verbatim.

members.name: children
members.summary: Child nodes, walked recursively.

members.name: debugMetadataUrl
members.summary: URL/path of the `debug-metadata.json` covering this node.

members.name: nodeIndex
members.summary: Compile-time node identity, looked up in the UI source map.

exports.name: ResolveResult
exports.summary: Result of [`resolveField`](api:resolveField).

members.name: found
members.summary:
`true` when the resolver matched; `false` when the field is known
but no value matched (HTTP layer → 404).

members.name: payload
members.summary:
Present only when `found`. The value to JSON-serialize back to the
client (already unwrapped via `FieldResolver.payload`).

exports.name: RspeedyMeta
exports.summary: Rspeedy-emitted build context for a single template / entry.

members.name: bundlePath
members.summary:
The template filename pattern this metadata corresponds to (e.g.
`main/template.js`). Lets multi-entry projects identify which page
each metadata file belongs to without relying on storage-key
conventions.

members.name: entryFiles
members.summary:
Source files of the webpack entry/entries this debug-metadata
corresponds to, expressed as paths relative to the git rootDir
(falls back to the compiler context when not in a git repo).

Typically a single file, but webpack allows array-form entries and
Lynx splits each user entry into multiple webpack entries
internally — both cases produce multiple paths here.

exports.name: SourceMap
exports.summary:
Source Map v3 payload, per the [Source Map Revision 3 proposal](https://sourcemaps.info/spec.html).

Declared here (instead of imported from `source-map`) to keep this
package zero-dependency and prevent transitive consumers from pulling
the ~200 kB `source-map` runtime just for a TypeScript type.

members.name: file
members.summary: Generated output filename this map describes.

members.name: mappings
members.summary: VLQ-encoded mapping data.

members.name: names
members.summary: Symbol names referenced from `mappings`.

members.name: sections
members.summary:
Index-map sections, exclusive with the simple-map shape. Producers
either set `sections` (index map) or the other fields, not both.

members.name: sourceRoot
members.summary: Optional prefix prepended to every entry in `sources`.

members.name: sources
members.summary: Original source file URLs / identifiers.

members.name: sourcesContent
members.summary: Inline source contents, parallel to `sources`.

exports.name: SourceMapDebugSource
exports.summary: Source Map v3 debug data attached to a JS / CSS artifact.

members.name: filename
members.summary: Basename of the `.map` file, e.g. `main-thread.js.map`.

members.name: key
members.summary:
Identifier that platform-side reverse symbolication uses to match
this map. Defaults to the producing chunk's hash, matching the
`release` the `__DEBUG_METADATA_RELEASE__` banner reports at runtime.

members.name: map
members.summary: Full Source Map v3 payload.

members.name: path
members.summary: Bundler-relative path of the `.map` file, e.g. `.lynx/main/main-thread.js.map`.

exports.name: SourceMapSection
exports.summary: One section of an index source map.

exports.name: UiNode
exports.summary:
One UI node of the tree the Lynx engine dumps — the input to
[`remapUiTree`](api:remapUiTree). Three fields are read: `nodeIndex` and
`debugMetadataUrl` drive reverse-resolution, and `children` is walked
recursively. All three are optional because the engine emits nodes that
carry no source mapping (e.g. raw-text nodes have no `nodeIndex`); such
nodes pass through untouched. Every other field is opaque.

members.name: children
members.summary: Child nodes, walked recursively.

members.name: debugMetadataUrl
members.summary: URL/path of the `debug-metadata.json` covering this node.

members.name: nodeIndex
members.summary: Compile-time node identity, looked up in the UI source map.

exports.name: UiSourceLocation
exports.summary:
Source location recovered for a single UI node, in the shape the
reverse-resolved tree gains alongside its original fields.

members.name: column
members.summary: 1-based source column.

members.name: line
members.summary: 1-based source line.

members.name: repo
members.summary: `owner/repo` derived from the build's git remote, or `null`.

members.name: source
members.summary: Authored source path (relative to the project root), or `null`.

exports.name: UiSourceMapData
exports.summary:
Compact UI source map payload — the `uiSourceMap` field of
[`DebugMetadataAsset`](api:DebugMetadataAsset).

exports.name: UiSourceMapRecord
exports.summary: One UI source map record produced by the main-thread loader.

exports.name: DebugMetadataLoader
exports.summary:
Loads the [`DebugMetadataAsset`](api:DebugMetadataAsset) a node's `debugMetadataUrl` points
at. Supplied by the caller so the core stays free of I/O (the CLI wires
up `fetch` / `fs`); only called once per distinct URL.

exports.name: DebugSource
exports.summary:
One debug data source attached to an [`Artifact`](api:Artifact).

Tagged union so future debug data kinds (e.g. WASM debug info,
R-source-map) can be added without restructuring `artifacts[]`.

exports.name: FIELDS
exports.summary:
Field name → resolver. **HTTP layers read this directly.** Mutations
are honoured by the next request — the export is a live `Map` so
plugins can register their own fields at startup.

Adding a new field is a one-line `FIELDS.set('your-name', { ... })`.

exports.name: UI_SOURCE_MAP_RECORDS_BUILD_INFO
exports.summary:
`module.buildInfo[UI_SOURCE_MAP_RECORDS_BUILD_INFO]` is where the
main-thread loader stashes the [`UiSourceMapRecord`](api:UiSourceMapRecord) array it
extracts from a module, for `LynxDebugMetadataPlugin` to collect.

Lives in this zero-dependency schema package so producer
(`@lynx-js/react-webpack-plugin`'s loader) and consumer
(`@lynx-js/debug-metadata-rsbuild-plugin`) can both read the same
constant without taking a runtime dep on each other.

exports.name: assertUiNode

signatures.text: assertUiNode(value: unknown, path: string): asserts value is UiNode
signatures.summary:
Assert that a parsed value is a [`UiNode`](api:UiNode) tree. Use it at trust
boundaries — e.g. right after `JSON.parse`-ing an engine dump — so
malformed input fails fast with a located error (`$.children[1]`-style
path) instead of crashing deep inside resolution.

`nodeIndex`, `debugMetadataUrl` and `children` are all optional (the
engine emits nodes with no source mapping, such as raw text); they are
only rejected when present with the wrong type. A non-object, or a
`children` that is not an array, is always rejected.

signatures.summary:
Normalize a git remote URL (SSH or HTTP form) to an `owner/repo`
identifier, dropping any trailing `.git`. Returns `null` for empty

exports.name: remapUiTree

signatures.summary:
Reverse-resolve a UI node tree dumped by the Lynx engine.

Every node carrying both a `nodeIndex` and a `debugMetadataUrl` whose
`uiSourceMap` knows that index is annotated with [`UiSourceLocation`](api:UiSourceLocation)
fields (`repo`, `source`, `line`, `column`). All other fields — and nodes
that cannot be resolved — pass through verbatim. The input is not
mutated; a new tree is returned.

exports.name: resolveField
exports.type: resolveField(metadata: DebugMetadataAsset, field: string, params: QueryParams): ResolveResult | undefined

signatures.text: resolveField(metadata: DebugMetadataAsset, field: string, params: QueryParams): ResolveResult | undefined
signatures.summary:
Resolve a `?field=…` query against parsed metadata.

- Returns `undefined` when the field is not registered — HTTP layer
  responds `400 invalid_field` and lists `knownFields()`.
- Returns `{found: false}` when the field is valid but no value
  matched — HTTP layer responds `404`.
- Returns `{found: true, payload}` when matched. `payload` is the
  already-unwrapped value (resolver's `payload` hook applied).
